title: Network topology diagram
description: Auto-generates a visual network topology showing VNets, peerings, subnets, gateways, and connected resources.
example_prompt: "Generate a Mermaid diagram showing the network topology for subscription '{subscription_name}'. Include all VNets, their subnets, peering connections, VPN/ExpressRoute gateways, private endpoints, and key resources in each subnet. Show address spaces and peering status."
